Known for her piety and charitable works, she was canonized in 1349.

Joelyssa, or Jolenta, was a Polish princess, the daughter of Casimir III the Great and Elizabeth Ruda of Hungary. She was born around 1370 and was married to Duke Albert III of Austria. She is remembered for her religious devotion and her role in the Council of Constance (1414-1418), where she interceded for the election of Pope Martin V.
